The '''E-19 blaster rifle''' was a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] used by some [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].

By [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], the E-19 had succeeded the [[E-15 blaster rifle|E-15]] and [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifles]].
